outcomes.methodology: WIN/LOSS is based on frozen canonical forward return in the signaled direction at the selected horizon. It is not TP/SL path settlement.

path_summary.methodology: Frozen SL/TP geometry settled from post-entry 5m candles; same-candle SL/TP conflicts are refined with 1m candles and remain ambiguous if order is still unknowable. execution scope requires score qualification plus valid directional geometry and R:R >= 1.0.
